liveboard.name: Amuzing chart samples
liveboard.description: Custom charts on the (Sample) Retail - Apparel model, arranged as one argument: where the money is, what sells, when, and what to do next.

tiles.title: Year to date against last year
Monthly columns, drill to a month
Monthly sales against last year
tiles.description: The dashed line is the same month a year earlier. The two largest month-on-month steps are marked. Hover for the month.

tiles.title: Year to date sales by region
tiles.description: Change in year-to-date sales by region. Click a region to split it into states.

tiles.title: Sales pace by year
tiles.description: Cumulative sales by month, one line per year. Click a line to open that year.

tiles.title: Sales by state
tiles.description: Bubble size is sales or stores. Click a state to zoom in and see its stores.

tiles.title: State sales as a hex map
tiles.description: One hex per state, shaded by sales. Click a hex to pin it.

tiles.title: Quarterly sales by store
tiles.description: Thirty mini charts. Toggle scale and sort; click a store to expand it.

tiles.title: Store sales, this year against last
tiles.description: Each store against the same quarters last year. Click a store for its quarters.

tiles.title: Region by item type
tiles.description: Sales, or share of the region, for each region and item type. Click a row or column to isolate it.

tiles.title: Where the money flows
tiles.description: Sales flow from region to family to item type. Hover a flow; click a node to isolate its flows.

tiles.title: Sales by family, item type and product
tiles.description: Click a wedge to zoom in; click the centre to zoom out.

tiles.title: Region to family chord
tiles.description: Hover a ribbon. Click a family arc to open its item types.

tiles.title: Sales treemap with drill-down
tiles.description: Click a rectangle to zoom in: family, item type, product.

tiles.title: Item types as radial bars
tiles.description: Click a bar for that item type's top products.

tiles.title: Region by family Marimekko
tiles.description: Column width is the region's sales. Click a column to split it into item types.

tiles.title: Products that make 80% of sales
tiles.description: Ranked bars and the cumulative line. Pick an item type; click a bar for its detail.

tiles.title: Price against volume by item type
tiles.description: Bubble area is sales, colour is family. The lines mark the average price and the median units.

tiles.title: How to read price against volume
tiles.description: The four quadrants of the chart beside it. Click one to list them.

tiles.title: Monthly sales around the year
tiles.description: Twelve months on a clock, one line per year. Click a year in the key to isolate it.

tiles.title: Sales ridgeline by year
tiles.description: One ridge per year. Click a ridge to open its months.

tiles.title: Sales, units and price by month
tiles.description: Year by month. Click a year to open its twelve months.

tiles.title: Sales by product family, by quarter
tiles.description: Stream, stacked or 100 percent. Click a family to open its item types.

tiles.title: Item types in motion by quarter
tiles.description: Press Play or scrub the quarters. Click a bubble to follow it.

tiles.title: Item type rank by year
tiles.description: Rank or sales by year. 2021 and the latest year are part years. Click a line to pin it.

tiles.title: Store race: cumulative sales by quarter
tiles.description: Press Play or scrub the quarters. Click a store to follow it.

tiles.title: Products by sales
tiles.description: All products. Sort, search, filter by family; click a row for its detail.

tiles.title: Family waffle: share of sales or units
tiles.description: One hundred squares. Toggle sales and units; click a family to list its item types.

tiles.title: Region profiles: family mix against average
tiles.description: Each region's family shares against the all-region average. Click a region to enlarge it.

tiles.title: Stores across five measures
tiles.description: Drag an axis to filter stores; click a line to pin it.

tiles.title: Every product by price per unit
tiles.description: Dot area is sales. Filter by family; click a dot for its card.

tiles.title: Share of sales against price per unit
tiles.description: Item types as bubbles. Year-to-date change is flat for every type, so share and price are what differ.

tiles.title: Moves the numbers support
tiles.description: Generated from the rows. Click a move to see its evidence.

tiles.title: Year-end outlook
tiles.description: Actual to date, then two labelled projections. Pick a scenario.

tiles.title: What if the rest of the year moves
tiles.description: Drag the sliders to reshape the remaining months.

tiles.title: Stores below last year
tiles.description: Move the threshold to flag stores below it. Click a row to pin it.
